gates.title: Baseline and compatibility
gates.pass_criteria: Exact remote base, isolated worktrees, real package feature probes and frozen contract/hash; no unrelated changes overwritten.
gates.required_evidence: Git metadata, package/feature-probe log, ownership register

gates.title: Architecture preservation
gates.pass_criteria: Legacy answers, composer/model choice, approvals, voice and existing contracts work without an artifact; Manager remains structured.
gates.required_evidence: Contract tests and baseline/candidate diff

gates.title: Real generation
gates.pass_criteria: At least 29/30 normal real-model initial generations structurally valid first pass; all 30 functional after at most one allowed repair; fixtures/fallbacks not counted as generated success.
gates.required_evidence: 30 source-hashed cases and parser/render outcomes

gates.title: Deployed streaming
gates.pass_criteria: Three deliberately separated chunks received/rendered before stream completion on deployed authenticated route; UTF-8 fragmentation and cancellation pass.
gates.required_evidence: Client/server monotonic timing and network capture

gates.title: Reactive queries
gates.pass_criteria: Changing filters updates real bounded data without any LLM call; deduplication, cancellation, expiry and hidden-tab refresh suspension pass.
gates.required_evidence: Query traces, model-attempt delta=0, service assertions

gates.title: No automatic writes
gates.pass_criteria: Query(writeName), mount, validation, replay, refresh and malformed @Run attempts cause zero business writes.
gates.required_evidence: Negative tests with DB/audit before-and-after

gates.title: Authorization and isolation
gates.pass_criteria: Owner/editor/viewer and another tenant plus founder identity tested; foreign IDs, replay and midstream scope switch reveal no foreign content.
gates.required_evidence: Real authenticated DB/API negatives, no service-role bypass

gates.title: Original approval paths
gates.pass_criteria: Exact role/revision/digest/expiry/timezone confirmed; prepared is not applied; no new approval system.
gates.required_evidence: Proposal apply/dismiss service receipts and stale negatives

gates.title: Idempotency
gates.pass_criteria: Double click, two tabs, same-key retry and disconnect after commit produce one domain effect; same key/different inputs conflicts.
gates.required_evidence: Concurrent DB tests and authoritative command/audit counts

gates.title: Incremental editing
gates.pass_criteria: All nine journey edit cases patch correct base with stable selections/dirty state; stale hash/revision denied; no unintended query/action expansion.
gates.required_evidence: Before/after source hashes, state assertions and edit test evidence

gates.title: Durability and reopen
gates.pass_criteria: Reload/restoration works from persisted artifacts; old version fallback and revoked-source access checks work; passive reopen/replay has zero provider attempts.
gates.required_evidence: DB restart/replay/browser tests plus attempt counts

gates.title: Failure isolation
gates.pass_criteria: Malformed output, oversized source, render error, query failure, provider failure/timeout/disconnect preserve native answer and last valid revision.
gates.required_evidence: Fault-injection corpus, error metadata and screenshot evidence

gates.title: Accounting
gates.pass_criteria: Generation/edit/repair reserves within combined turn budget; known/unknown usage, cancel and provider failures reconcile once; no hidden retries or free extra route.
gates.required_evidence: Ledger/attempt assertions and budget-denial tests

gates.title: Privacy and egress
gates.pass_criteria: No unapproved cloud sink/route, no browser keys, safe logs, source consent and local-only policies preserved; installation telemetry disabled.
gates.required_evidence: Config diff, network allowlist inspection and redaction tests

gates.title: Responsive and real iPhone
gates.pass_criteria: Desktop 1440px, panel 360px, tablet 768px, mobile 390px portrait and landscape; real iPhone Safari validates keyboard/scroll/forms/reconnect.
gates.required_evidence: Named browser/device versions, captures and tested flows

gates.title: Accessibility and localization
gates.pass_criteria: No critical/serious axe issues in tested surfaces; keyboard/focus/readable status/chart alternatives; EN/Traditional/Simplified Chinese and existing locales not regressed.
gates.required_evidence: axe outputs, manual keyboard/screen-reader and locale results

gates.title: Measured performance
gates.pass_criteria: Local state/filter interaction p95 <=200ms over 100 warm actions; warm first useful component p95 <=8s from presentation admission; normal full UI p95 <=30s; record cold path separately.
gates.required_evidence: Same-runner timing samples, provider/network context and declared time origins

gates.title: Resource limits
gates.pass_criteria: 128KiB source, 32KiB patch, 512 statements, depth24, query/page/state caps enforced; hidden artifacts have no active polling; scope switch aborts in-flight requests.
gates.required_evidence: Boundary tests, subscription counts and network logs

gates.title: Voice continuity
gates.pass_criteria: Same conversation/artifact/selected refs in text and browser voice; speakableSummary has no DSL; ambiguous approval stays ambiguous; shared phone runtime regressions pass.
gates.required_evidence: Voice integration and non-outbound runtime test evidence

gates.title: Existing app regression
gates.pass_criteria: Auth/workspace switch, chat, draft edit, Library, memory consent, credits, approvals, automation and voice tests pass against integrated SHA.
gates.required_evidence: Required existing suites, regression diff and logs

gates.title: Truthful unavailable states
gates.pass_criteria: Unknown metrics do not become zero; external connector/consent/approval gaps visible with useful recovery, not fabricated normal-path success.
gates.required_evidence: Empty/partial/denied/unavailable cases and capability manifest

gates.title: Safe schema and deployment
gates.pass_criteria: Only necessary additive schema/index work; tested rollback-compatible old readers; exact route order prevents accidental API shadowing.
gates.required_evidence: Migration rehearsal, compatibility tests and route smoke

gates.title: Kill switch and rollback
gates.pass_criteria: Disable GenUI and new actions safely while native chat/approvals work; revert application without destructive data loss or duplicate commands.
gates.required_evidence: Flag drill, rollback rehearsal and reconciliation output

gates.title: Production activation
gates.pass_criteria: Exact merged SHA deployed at verified canonical rafii.io, authenticated smoke passes, enabled for intended eligible users; not preview-only or flags permanently off.
gates.required_evidence: PR/CI/deployment/origin/activation receipt

gates.title: Completion evidence
gates.pass_criteria: All required gates pass for final SHA; real-device/provider/DB checks not replaced by mocks; unresolved external prerequisites clearly invalidate affected readiness claims.
gates.required_evidence: Final signed-off matrix and release receipt

gates.title: Draft studio
gates.pass_criteria: Complete normal path with actual authorized application services and expected record/state assertions; also verify empty/denied/partial/failure states. External publication is not required or authorized.
gates.required_evidence: Real-service journey log, UI capture and relevant DB/proposal/learning/metric source receipt
